steps.note: MMS login page. Engine /session/<id>/qr reads the square canvas QR (拼多多). Do not wrap window.fetch — PDD fbeZ fingerprint.

args.predicate: (function(){var cs=document.querySelectorAll('canvas');for(var i=0;i<cs.length;i++){var c=cs[i];if(c.width>=80&&c.width<=480&&Math.abs(c.width-c.height)<=4)return true;}return /二维码|扫一扫|多多商家/.test((document.body&&document.body.innerText)||'');})()

steps.note: QR canvas (or 扫码文案) on page. Receipt already has live_qr — open it for the human now; do not wait for qr_shot.
debug/archive full-page only. Humans scan receipt.live_qr with 多多商家 App — never this PNG.
HUMAN: open receipt.live_qr (GET /session/<id>/qr/live), scan with 多多商家 App + confirm. Never send a static PNG. Early handoff: vars.login_timeout_ms:1000 then poll /session/:id/wait yourself.
Witness off /login. Stamp with POST /account/verify {name, url:home/, predicate: hostname mms && path not /login}. session_id composes into pinduoduo-publish.

note_live_qr: Hand the person receipt.live_qr (GET /session/<id>/qr/live on this engine): a page that re-reads the code the login page shows every second. Never send a static screenshot/PNG — it expires before the phone is in hand. Scan with 多多商家 App.
